messages.subject: Bootstrap CSS themes
parts:
FAO the Shiny devs:

A question for you about your article on CSS styling http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/css.html

It mentions that the Shiny UI is built with the Bootstrap 2.3.2 HTML/CSS framework; however, I tried applying some 2.3.2 themes to my Shiny App today, and these did not work as well as the v3 (current) themes.

Maybe there's something odd about my app, or is it time to update this note?

best, Andrew
